instruction_en: Passing a stopped waste truck with amber lights, move to the adjacent lane.
scene: Stopped garbage truck with flashing amber lights in lane ahead

text: (b) If the maneuver described in subdivision (a) would be unsafe or impractical, a driver approaching and overtaking a stopped waste service vehicle shall slow to a reasonable and prudent speed that is safe for existing weather, road, and vehicular or pedestrian traffic conditions.
instruction: 차로를 옮길 수 없으면 정차한 청소차 옆에서 안전한 속도로 감속하십시오.
instruction_en: If you cannot change lanes, slow to a safe speed near the waste truck.
scene: Stopped garbage truck with amber lights and no free adjacent lane

text: (a) The driver of a vehicle intending to turn to the left or to complete a U-turn upon a highway, or to turn left into public or private property, or an alley, shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching from the opposite direction which are close enough to constitute a hazard at any time during the turning movement, and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to the approaching vehicles until the left turn or U-turn can be made with reasonable safety.
instruction: 좌회전이나 유턴할 때 위험한 거리의 맞은편 차량에게 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: When turning left or making a U-turn, yield to close oncoming vehicles.
scene: Oncoming vehicles approaching while waiting to turn left

text: (b) A driver having yielded as prescribed in subdivision (a), and having given a signal when and as required by this code, may turn left or complete a U-turn, and the drivers of vehicles approaching the intersection or the entrance to the property or alley from the opposite direction shall yield the right-of-way to the turning vehicle.
instruction: 양보하고 신호를 낸 좌회전 차량에게 맞은편 차량은 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: Oncoming drivers must yield to a vehicle that yielded, signaled, and turns left.
scene: Oncoming vehicle with left turn signal turning across your lane

text: No person shall start a vehicle stopped, standing, or parked on a highway, nor shall any person back a vehicle on a highway until such movement can be made with reasonable safety.
instruction: 출발하거나 후진할 때는 안전이 확보된 뒤에 하십시오.
instruction_en: Start from a stop or back up only when it can be done safely.
scene: Parked vehicle at the curb pulling out into traffic

text: No person shall turn a vehicle from a direct course or move right or left upon a roadway until such movement can be made with reasonable safety and then only after the giving of an appropriate signal in the manner provided in this chapter in the event any other vehicle may be affected by the movement.
instruction: 방향을 바꾸거나 차로를 옮길 때는 안전을 확인하고 신호를 내십시오.
instruction_en: Turn or change lanes only when safe, and signal if others are affected.
scene: Multi-lane road with vehicles in adjacent lane during a lane change

text: Any signal of intention to turn right or left shall be given continuously during the last 100 feet traveled by the vehicle before turning.
instruction: 회전하기 전 마지막 100피트 동안 방향지시등을 계속 켜십시오.
instruction_en: Signal continuously during the last 100 feet before turning.
scene: Approach to an intersection or driveway before a turn

text: No person shall stop or suddenly decrease the speed of a vehicle on a highway without first giving an appropriate signal in the manner provided in this chapter to the driver of any vehicle immediately to the rear when there is opportunity to give the signal.
instruction: 정지하거나 급감속하기 전에 뒤차에 신호를 내십시오.
instruction_en: Signal to the vehicle behind before stopping or suddenly slowing.
scene: Following vehicle close behind as traffic ahead slows

text: (a) The signals required by this chapter shall be given by signal lamp, unless a vehicle is not required to be and is not equipped with turn signals. Drivers of vehicles not required to be and not equipped with turn signals shall give a hand and arm signal when required by this chapter.
instruction: 방향 신호는 방향지시등으로 내십시오.
instruction_en: Give required turn signals with the vehicle's signal lamps.
scene: Vehicle approaching a turn with turn signal lamp flashing

text: (a) No person shall drive a vehicle on any bridge, elevated structure, tube, or tunnel constituting a part of a highway, at a speed which is greater than the maximum speed which can be maintained with safety to such structure.
instruction: 교량·고가구조물·터널에서는 안전 최고속도를 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not exceed the safe maximum speed on bridges or tunnels.
scene: Approaching a bridge or tunnel entrance with a speed sign

text: (a) It is unlawful for any person to park or leave standing any vehicle in a stall or space designated for disabled persons and disabled veterans pursuant to Section 22511.7 or 22511.8 of this code or Section 14679 of the Government Code, unless the vehicle displays either a special identification license plate issued pursuant to Section 5007 or a distinguishing placard issued pursuant to Section 22511.55 or 22511.59.
instruction: 장애인 전용 주차 구역에는 표지나 번호판 없이 주차하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not park in a disabled space without a plate or placard.
scene: Parking stall marked with the disabled symbol

text: (b) It is unlawful for any person to obstruct, block, or otherwise bar access to those parking stalls or spaces except as provided in subdivision (a).
instruction: 장애인 전용 주차 구역으로의 접근을 막지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not block access to disabled parking spaces.
scene: Disabled parking stall with an access aisle in a lot

text: (c) It is unlawful for any person to park or leave standing any vehicle, including a vehicle displaying a special identification license plate issued pursuant to Section 5007 or a distinguishing placard issued pursuant to Section 22511.55 or 22511.59, in either of the following places: (1) On the lines marking the boundaries of a parking stall or space designated for disabled persons or disabled veterans. (2) In any area of the pavement adjacent to a parking stall or space designated for disabled persons or disabled veterans that is marked by crosshatched lines and is thereby designated, pursu
instruction: 장애인 주차 구역 경계선 위에는 표지가 있어도 주차하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Never park on the lines of a disabled space, even with a placard.
scene: Painted boundary lines of a disabled parking stall

text: (c) It is unlawful for any person to park or leave standing any vehicle, including a vehicle displaying a special identification license plate issued pursuant to Section 5007 or a distinguishing placard issued pursuant to Section 22511.55 or 22511.59, in either of the following places: (1) On the lines marking the boundaries of a parking stall or space designated for disabled persons or disabled veterans. (2) In any area of the pavement adjacent to a parking stall or space designated for disabled persons or disabled veterans that is marked by crosshatched lines and is thereby designated, pursu
instruction: 장애인 주차 구역 옆 빗금 표시 구역에는 주차하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not park in crosshatched areas beside disabled parking spaces.
scene: Crosshatched pavement markings beside a disabled parking stall

text: (a) A person shall not drive a motor vehicle while using a wireless telephone unless that telephone is specifically designed and configured to allow hands-free listening and talking, and is used in that manner while driving.
instruction: 운전 중에는 핸즈프리가 아닌 무선 전화를 사용하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not use a wireless phone while driving unless hands-free.
scene: Driver holding a phone while driving on a road

text: The authorities in charge of any highway may designate any highway, roadway, part of a roadway, or specific lanes upon which vehicular traffic shall proceed in one direction at all or such times as shall be indicated by official traffic control devices. When a roadway has been so designated, a vehicle shall be driven only in the direction designated at all or such times as shall be indicated by traffic control devices.
instruction: 일방통행으로 지정된 도로·차로에서는 지정된 방향으로만 주행하십시오.
instruction_en: On one-way roads or lanes, drive only in the designated direction.
scene: One-way sign with an arrow along a roadway

text: Whenever any roadway has been divided into two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic in one direction, the following rules apply: (a) A vehicle shall be driven as nearly as practical entirely within a single lane and shall not be moved from the lane until such movement can be made with reasonable safety.
instruction: 다차로 도로에서는 한 차로로 주행하고 안전할 때만 변경하십시오.
instruction_en: Stay within one lane and change lanes only when reasonably safe.
scene: One-way road with several clearly marked lanes

text: Whenever any roadway has been divided into two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic in one direction, the following rules apply: (b) Official signs may be erected directing slow-moving traffic to use a designated lane or allocating specified lanes to traffic moving in the same direction, and drivers of vehicles shall obey the directions of the traffic device.
instruction: 차로를 지정하는 표지가 있으면 그 지시에 따르십시오.
instruction_en: Obey signs that assign slow traffic or specified lanes.
scene: Overhead sign assigning slow vehicles to a designated lane

text: Upon a roadway which is divided into three lanes a vehicle shall not be driven in the extreme left lane at any time, nor in the center lane except when overtaking and passing another vehicle where the roadway ahead is clearly visible and the center lane is clear of traffic within a safe distance, or in preparation for a left turn, or where the center lane is at the time allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction the vehicle is proceeding and is signposted to give notice of such allocation. This section does not apply upon a one-way roadway.
instruction: 일방통행이 아닌 3차로 도로에서는 맨 왼쪽 차로로 주행하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: On a three-lane roadway, never drive in the extreme left lane.
scene: Two-way roadway with three lanes and the leftmost lane ahead

text: Upon a roadway which is divided into three lanes a vehicle shall not be driven in the extreme left lane at any time, nor in the center lane except when overtaking and passing another vehicle where the roadway ahead is clearly visible and the center lane is clear of traffic within a safe distance, or in preparation for a left turn, or where the center lane is at the time allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction the vehicle is proceeding and is signposted to give notice of such allocation. This section does not apply upon a one-way roadway.
instruction: 양방향 3차로 도로의 가운데 차로는 앞지르기·좌회전 때만 쓰십시오.
instruction_en: On a three-lane roadway, use the center lane only to pass or turn left.
scene: Two-way three-lane roadway with the center lane ahead

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop as required by Section 22450. The driver shall then yield the right-of-way to any vehicles which have approached from another highway, or which are approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard, and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to those vehicles until he or she can proceed with reasonable safety.
instruction: 정지 표지 앞에서는 완전히 정지하십시오.
instruction_en: Stop completely at a stop sign.
scene: Red octagonal stop sign at an intersection entrance

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop as required by Section 22450. The driver shall then yield the right-of-way to any vehicles which have approached from another highway, or which are approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard, and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to those vehicles until he or she can proceed with reasonable safety.
instruction: 정지 후에는 교차 도로 차량과 임박한 위험 차량에 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: After stopping, yield to cross traffic and any immediate hazard.
scene: Stopped at a stop sign with cross traffic approaching

text: (b) A driver having yielded as prescribed in subdivision (a) may proceed to enter the intersection, and the drivers of all other approaching vehicles shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle entering or crossing the intersection.
instruction: 정지 표지에서 양보를 마치고 진입하는 차량에는 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: Yield to a vehicle that has yielded and is entering the intersection.
scene: Vehicle from a stop sign entering the intersection ahead

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle approaching any intersection which is controlled by a yield right-of-way sign shall, upon arriving at the sign, yield the right-of-way to any vehicles which have entered the intersection, or which are approaching on the intersecting highway close enough to constitute an immediate hazard, and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to those vehicles until he or she can proceed with reasonable safety.
instruction: 양보 표지에서는 교차로에 진입한 차량과 임박한 위험 차량에 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: At a yield sign, yield to vehicles in or approaching the intersection.
scene: Yield sign with vehicles on the intersecting road

text: (b) A driver having yielded as prescribed in subdivision (a) may proceed to enter the intersection, and the drivers of all other approaching vehicles shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle entering or crossing the intersection.
instruction: 양보 표지에서 양보를 마치고 진입하는 차량에는 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: Yield to a vehicle that has yielded and is entering the intersection.
scene: Vehicle from a yield sign entering the intersection ahead

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle about to enter or cross a highway from any public or private property, or from an alley, shall yield the right-of-way to all traffic, as defined in Section 620, approaching on the highway close enough to constitute an immediate hazard, and shall continue to yield the right-of-way to that traffic until he or she can proceed with reasonable safety.
instruction: 사유지·골목에서 도로로 진입할 때는 접근하는 차량에 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: When entering a road from property or an alley, yield to traffic.
scene: Driveway or alley exit onto a road with approaching traffic

text: (b) A driver having yielded as prescribed in subdivision (a) may proceed to enter or cross the highway, and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching on the highway shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle entering or crossing the intersection.
instruction: 사유지·골목에서 양보를 마치고 도로로 진입하는 차량에는 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: Yield to a vehicle that has yielded and is entering the road.
scene: Vehicle pulling out of a driveway onto the road ahead

text: (a) Except as provided in Section 22356, no person may drive a vehicle upon a highway at a speed greater than 65 miles per hour.
instruction: 도로에서는 시속 65마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not drive faster than 65 miles per hour.
scene: Open highway with a 65 mph speed limit sign

text: (b) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, no person may drive a vehicle upon a two-lane, undivided highway at a speed greater than 55 miles per hour unless that highway, or portion thereof, has been posted for a higher speed by the Department of Transportation or appropriate local agency upon the basis of an engineering and traffic survey. For purposes of this subdivision, the following apply: (1) A two-lane, undivided highway is a highway with not more than one through lane of travel in each direction. (2) Passing lanes may not be considered when determining the number of through lanes.
instruction: 상향 표지 없는 2차로 비분리 도로에서는 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: On two-lane undivided highways, do not exceed 55 mph unless posted higher.
scene: Two-lane undivided highway with no posted higher limit

text: No person shall operate any vehicle equipped with any metal tire in contact with the surface of the highway at a speed in excess of six miles per hour.
instruction: 금속 타이어 차량은 노면에서 시속 6마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not exceed six miles per hour with metal tires on the road.
scene: Vehicle with metal tires on a road surface

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (a) A motortruck or truck tractor having three or more axles or any motortruck or truck tractor drawing any other vehicle.
instruction: 3축 이상이거나 다른 차를 끄는 화물차는 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Trucks with three or more axles or towing must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Heavy multi-axle truck or truck towing another vehicle on a highway

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (b) A passenger vehicle or bus drawing any other vehicle.
instruction: 다른 차량을 끄는 승용차·버스는 시속 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Passenger vehicles or buses towing another vehicle must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Passenger vehicle or bus towing a trailer on a highway

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (c) A schoolbus transporting any school pupil.
instruction: 학생을 태운 스쿨버스는 시속 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: A schoolbus carrying pupils must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Yellow schoolbus carrying students on a highway

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (d) A farm labor vehicle when transporting passengers.
instruction: 승객을 태운 농장 노동자 차량은 시속 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: A farm labor vehicle carrying passengers must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Farm labor vehicle carrying passengers on a rural road

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (e) A vehicle transporting explosives.
instruction: 폭발물을 운반하는 차량은 시속 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: A vehicle transporting explosives must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Truck with explosives placards on a highway

text: No person may drive any of the following vehicles on a highway at a speed in excess of 55 miles per hour: (f) A trailer bus, as defined in Section 636.
instruction: 트레일러 버스는 시속 55마일을 넘지 마십시오.
instruction_en: A trailer bus must not exceed 55 mph.
scene: Bus pulling a trailer on a highway

text: No person shall operate an unauthorized motor vehicle on any state, county, city, private, or district hiking or horseback riding trail or bicycle path that is clearly marked by an authorized agent or owner with signs at all entrances and exits and at intervals of not more than one mile indicating no unauthorized motor vehicles are permitted on the hiking or horseback riding trail or bicycle path, except bicycle paths which are contiguous or adjacent to a roadway dedicated solely to motor vehicle use. For the purpose of this section “unauthorized motor vehicle” means any motor vehicle that is
instruction: 자동차 금지 표지가 있는 하이킹·승마·자전거 도로에는 진입하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not enter marked hiking, horse, or bicycle trails closed to motor vehicles.
scene: Trail entrance with a sign prohibiting motor vehicles

text: The driver of a motor vehicle traveling through defiles or canyons or upon mountain highways shall hold the motor vehicle under control at all times and shall do the following when applicable:
instruction: 산악도로·협곡을 지날 때는 항상 차량을 통제하십시오.
instruction_en: Keep the vehicle under control in canyons and on mountain highways.
scene: Winding mountain highway through a canyon

text: The driver of a motor vehicle traveling through defiles or canyons or upon mountain highways shall hold the motor vehicle under control at all times and shall do the following when applicable: (a) If the roadway has no marked centerline, the driver shall drive as near the right-hand edge of the roadway as is reasonably possible.
instruction: 중앙선 없는 산악도로·협곡에서는 도로 오른쪽 끝에 붙어 주행하십시오.
instruction_en: On mountain roads without a centerline, drive near the right edge.
scene: Narrow mountain road with no centerline

text: The driver of a motor vehicle traveling through defiles or canyons or upon mountain highways shall hold the motor vehicle under control at all times and shall do the following when applicable: (b) If the roadway has insufficient width to permit a motor vehicle to be driven entirely to the right of the center of the roadway, the driver shall give audible warning with the horn of the motor vehicle upon approaching any curve where the view is obstructed within a distance of 200 feet along the highway.
instruction: 폭이 좁고 200피트 안이 가려진 산악 커브에서는 경적을 울리십시오.
instruction_en: On narrow mountain roads, honk before curves with view blocked within 200 feet.
scene: Blind curve on a narrow mountain road

text: Except as expressly permitted pursuant to this code, including Sections 21100.4 and 21114.5, no person shall operate or move a motor vehicle upon a sidewalk except as may be necessary to enter or leave adjacent property.
instruction: 인접 부지 출입 외에는 보도 위로 주행하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not drive on a sidewalk except to enter or leave adjacent property.
scene: Sidewalk beside a road with a curb

text: No person shall drive a vehicle when it is so loaded, or when there are in the front seat such number of persons as to obstruct the view of the driver to the front or sides of the vehicle or as to interfere with the driver’s control over the driving mechanism of the vehicle.
instruction: 시야나 조작을 방해하도록 싣거나 앞좌석에 태우고 주행하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not drive with a load or passengers blocking view or control.
scene: Vehicle cargo or crowded front seat obstructing the driver's view

text: Whenever upon any grade the width of the roadway is insufficient to permit the passing of vehicles approaching from opposite directions at the point of meeting, the driver of the vehicle descending the grade shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle ascending the grade and shall, if necessary, back his vehicle to a place in the highway where it is possible for the vehicles to pass.
instruction: 폭이 좁은 비탈길에서는 내려가는 차가 올라오는 차에 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: On narrow grades, the descending vehicle yields to the ascending vehicle.
scene: Narrow sloped road with an oncoming vehicle climbing

text: (b) The driver of any vehicle shall yield the right-of-way to any horseback rider who is crossing the highway at any designated equestrian crossing which is marked by signs as prescribed in subdivision (a).
instruction: 표지된 승마 횡단로에서는 건너는 기수에게 양보하십시오.
instruction_en: Yield to horseback riders at marked equestrian crossings.
scene: Equestrian crossing sign with a horse rider crossing

text: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle which is sounding a siren and which has at least one lighted lamp exhibiting red light that is visible, under normal atmospheric conditions, from a distance of 1,000 feet to the front of the vehicle, the surrounding traffic shall, except as otherwise directed by a traffic officer, do the following: (a) (1) Except as required under paragraph (2), the driver of every other vehicle shall yield the right-of-way and shall immediately drive to the right-hand edge or curb of the highway, clear of any intersection, and thereupon shall stop
instruction: 사이렌 울리는 긴급차량이 접근하면 양보하고 우측 가장자리로 이동하십시오.
instruction_en: Yield to approaching sirened emergency vehicles and move to the right edge.
scene: Emergency vehicle with siren and red lights approaching from behind

text: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle which is sounding a siren and which has at least one lighted lamp exhibiting red light that is visible, under normal atmospheric conditions, from a distance of 1,000 feet to the front of the vehicle, the surrounding traffic shall, except as otherwise directed by a traffic officer, do the following: (a) (1) Except as required under paragraph (2), the driver of every other vehicle shall yield the right-of-way and shall immediately drive to the right-hand edge or curb of the highway, clear of any intersection, and thereupon shall stop
instruction: 긴급차량이 접근하면 교차로 밖 우측에 정지해 지나갈 때까지 기다리십시오.
instruction_en: Stop clear of intersections at the right until the emergency vehicle passes.
scene: Vehicle stopped at the right edge as an emergency vehicle passes

text: Whenever any vehicle has stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway the driver of any other vehicle approaching from the rear shall not overtake and pass the stopped vehicle.
instruction: 횡단보도에 정차한 차량은 뒤에서 추월하지 마십시오.
instruction_en: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk.
scene: Car stopped before crosswalk with pedestrian crossing, vehicle approaching from behind

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection. If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
instruction: 정지 표지판 앞에서는 정지선 또는 횡단보도 앞에 정지하십시오.
instruction_en: Stop at the limit line or before the crosswalk at a stop sign.
scene: Red stop sign at intersection with white limit line and crosswalk

text: (a) The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection. If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
instruction: 정지선과 횡단보도가 없으면 교차 도로 입구에 정지하십시오.
instruction_en: With no limit line or crosswalk, stop at the intersecting roadway entrance.
scene: Stop sign at intersection with no limit line or crosswalk

text: (b) The driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at a railroad grade crossing shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before crossing the first track or entrance to the railroad grade crossing.
instruction: 건널목 정지 표지판 앞에서는 정지선 또는 첫 선로 앞에 정지하십시오.
instruction_en: Stop at the limit line or before the first track at a crossing stop sign.

text: (a) No person shall evade or attempt to evade the payment of tolls or other charges on any vehicular crossing or toll highway.
